questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct option that will complete the series.

(3, 10), (5, 28), (7, 54), ?, (13, 180 )
questions.solution:
First term is a prime number increasing: 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 …

Second term = (prime number)² + (prime number − 2).

Check:

3 → 3² + (3−2) = 9 + 1 = 10 ✔

5 → 5² + (5−2) = 25 + 3 = 28 ✔

7 → 7² + (7−2) = 49 + 5 = 54 ✔

Next prime after 7 is 11 → 11² + (11−2) = 121 + 9 = 130 ✔

Next given 13 → 13² + (13−2) = 169 + 11 = 180 ✔

So missing pair = (11, 130) .
